这小怪组合是人想出来的吗？本来船锚就够恶心了封走位就让人不敢进攻了，还一下来三个船锚，然后三个船锚还不是同时封你的是轮流封锁，然后封完半个屏幕就都是他们的弹幕了，然后中间还放个大眼追着我滋激光，开了技能都一点反抗能力没有，感觉就是碰到稳掉好多血的，一点不合理 2编：又打了下，天胡局通关了，排行榜15名，还是那个问题，难度也太不合理了，拿到的暴击三倍伤害和对单必暴击，本来觉得都随便过了，谁知道F盘的boss更是拉了坨大的，你告诉我这boss和前三个boss是一个游戏里的？？我天胡局加4.5格血和一格护甲，打完就tm剩半血，差点翻车，前面几个boss也都有一两招感觉很难躲的，但也都还行，输出空间也有也有一些白给招，第四个boss你告诉我除了弹幕攻击其他技能都是人躲的吗？输出空间又是少的可怜，招式期间全是无敌，真的太不合理了这第四个boss。通关都还没两小时就不退了挺有风格的。但是不推荐，这难度正常人也很难体验到完整内容吧？啥时候难度调整好了啥时候改好评。 3编：又推给朋友玩了几把也是一样的问题，框怪打怪的系统太垃圾了，感觉就是游戏底层逻辑有问题，想了想还是准备退了。

[h1][b]《病毒识别：拯救系统》——开启一段另类的杀毒之旅[/b][/h1] [quote]Warning！Warning！！！电脑的操作系统突然遭到神秘病毒的深度感染，居然连360杀毒软件（误）对此都束手无策四处求救？！没办法，关键时刻还得靠我们亲自出马，缉拿罪魁祸首！[/quote] [h3]【游戏玩法】[/h3] 游戏一打开，画面着实惊艳到我了，这个操作系统界面仿佛回到了win XP、win 98的年代，小时候趴在桌前玩空当接龙和三维弹球，真是满满的回忆啊～强烈建议桌面系统可以进行多版本风格切换，比如win 7、win10之类的，这样工作也能爽爽摸鱼了哈哈（记得把设置中的CRT值和战斗背景值调到零，更能以假乱真）。 在游戏中，我们操控的物体就是鼠标光标，而病毒是藏匿于本地磁盘中的，所以点开“我的电脑”图标就是开始游戏；最开始是从C盘开始闯关，就好比地牢或者魔塔一样，每一个文件夹都是一个小房间，里面会刷出怪物，也就是受病毒感染的文件夹，图标上还会用病毒数量标注出难度等级，点击进入文件夹后就开始战斗了。战斗结束后，这个文件夹里损坏的马赛克文件则会恢复成原本的照片、文档，点击后收获金币用于在商店购买道具增强自身属性；运气不错的话，还能遇到宝箱，开锁后获得EXE应用程序，相当于一个主动技能，关键时刻还是很管用的。当前一共有C盘、D盘、E盘、F盘这4大关，击败当前盘符的Boss后即可进入下一场景。 这里有很多种类型的光标样式，每种不仅数值属性不同，就连杀怪方式也各不一样：初始光标是利用光标不停地画出闭合的圆圈圈住病毒以造成伤害，有的是通过将光标放置在病毒身上疯狂点击来攻击的，像这一类的就是手速有多快伤害就有多高（证明自己的时候到了）；如果想玩休闲点儿不那么累的话，也有这种自带一个小矩形框的光标，当框框接触到病毒时会周期性地造成伤害，这一类的就需要把握好时机，当病毒攻击时尽快远离避开，以免贪刀被打到了。当然这些还只是冰山一角，一共有多达15种不同玩法的光标可以解锁，肯定能找到非常适合你的那一款。 [h3]【不足之处】[/h3] [olist] [*]桌面系统风格比较古老，希望能增加多个版本切换功能，比如win 7、win10之类的。 [*]小怪比较好打，但Boss的难度完全是提升了好几个档次，弹幕密集攻速极快，前两个Boss还算勉强过关，第三个难度简直直线飞升，有点为了难而难的。 [*]有一定概率连续两把打的都是同一个种子，没有自动刷新种子号。 [/olist] [quote] 恭请雅鉴 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45531068/]黑白测评[/url] [hr]黑夜显真 白昼辨伪

I realize that this is in early access and for that, it is pretty decent, but they really should have had double the bosses at this point, having one alternate encounter for each area. The items are also pretty lackluster, most of them involving crit upgrades and health boosts. There are some treasure items, which are the best part of the game so far, but they aren't as OP as they need to be since they are basically single-use items for the most part. Some of them clutter up the screen and make it harder to dodge as well, like the fire item. It barely gets a non-recommendation because it is fun, but for a roguelite/roguelike, it basically the same experience on every single run and that is a huge dealbreaker for me. I will say that I haven't unlocked a lot of the cursors but all they do is change your attack, so they seem to change your approach to playing the game, but not by a lot... the ones that I have unlocked hardly change the experience. To clarify, each one changes your main attack and you only have one attack at a time (besides the single/limited use items) One last thing I'd like to mention is that this game is surprisingly difficult (at least for me) and I am shocked to see that 25% of the players already beat the final boss and the leaderboards are as high as they are. I can barely beat the 3rd boss and I have tried a bunch of times. I will update my review once it moves further along, but it is just not interesting enough to recommend right now.

很久以前在itch上玩过demo，非常喜欢，steam正式出了立马就入手了 比较轻松的肉鸽元素，鼠标指针就是角色的纯鼠标操作对数位板来说可太利好了， 本地化相当优秀，翻译出了一些会让人会心一笑又不会太密集的熟悉的东西 就是可惜内容比较短，只有四个大关卡后面就没有了，最后的第四个boss设计还是比较有意思的，但是还没爽玩就遗憾结束了 感觉这种文件夹形式的结构其实挺适合还做一点剧情模式？ 总之确实是短小精悍，目前的内容半小时左右就能通关了，要素也比较少，但是很有趣，期待以后的继续更新了
起初游戏默认的鼠标玩法有点灾难，但开始解决虚线正方形鼠标后 游戏开始变爽游，不可否认 游戏的每个鼠标玩法都不同但收益差距一个天一个地.游戏通关不难，BOSS的套路基本都是初见杀，但要冲击排行榜需要非常天湖和暴力的高暴击伤害. 重复游玩如果不是冲击排行感觉不那么耐玩，商店不能刷新 拿道具一定要看清文字说明 不是加伤害就是加攻击. 个人评价：7/10 选题不错，可玩性还可以 重复可玩性一般

[h1][b]用鼠标给电脑杀杀毒[/b][/h1] 电脑病毒，这种当年肆虐的恶意程序如今却几乎不见踪影，这款《病毒识别：拯救系统》则将电脑病毒具象化了，而杀毒的过程也很有意思，用鼠标画圈即可。 打开游戏是一个像素化桌面系统，蓝天白云的壁纸和左下角的按钮颇有当年WinXP系统的味道。 不幸的是这个系统被病毒感染了，目前需要做的就是清除病毒，不过本作中可没有什么勇者般的主角，玩家只能操控光标来行动。 首先需要获取资源来提升战斗力，这个过程也很有趣，具体操作便和我们平时使用资源管理器一样，双击文件夹即可。 其中大部分文件点击后都可以给到资源，还有一部分是商店和奖励等存在，其可以提升生命值、连击、暴击等属性。 还有一类非常明显的病毒文件，其带有骷髅头，点击后便会触发战斗。 此时将有各种具象化的病毒在屏幕上飞舞，玩家要做的就是用光标围着其快速转圈，如此便可杀毒，不过要注意不能直接碰到敌人，这个过程中也会有弹幕攻击出现，其同样需要躲避。 具体操作下来，感觉鼠标操控要比键盘操控简单多了，躲避弹幕也更加容易。 总的来说是部创意远胜于玩法的肉鸽游戏，怀旧的风格、操作系统般的操作、还有简洁的构筑系统，加在一起还是值得一玩的。 [quote]热爱游戏，畅玩游戏，分享游戏，专注鉴赏评测与深度解析 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44110339/]游理游据[/url]，走进游戏世界，品味第九艺术[/quote]

[h1] 「♥病毒识别：拯救系统♥」 [/h1] [h2] 「♥游戏介绍♥」 [/h2] 病毒识别：拯救系统是一款只用鼠标单手操作就能游玩的弹幕肉鸽游戏，游戏中玩家操控自己的超能鼠标指针，在一台电脑的各个磁盘中进行文件夹的大查杀吗，找到病毒并通过鼠标的方式将他们发现标注删除，游戏中有很多种不同的鼠标，从画圈到开枪，从点击到框选，不同的鼠标会有不同的攻击方式，玩家可以根据自己的喜好选择喜欢的攻击方式来进行游戏，还能购买各种装饰品，推荐给弹幕肉鸽爱好者游玩。 [h2] 「♥游戏内容♥」 [/h2] 游戏的剧情就是电脑里面已经被病毒塞满了，安全卫士已经瘫痪了，玩家要扮演被赋予了超能力的超级鼠标来消灭病毒，清理掉个个磁盘盘踞着的最终boss，让电脑重获新生。 游戏的玩法非常特殊，因为根据玩家的鼠标选择的不同，玩法也会随之改变，除去最开始的画圈的鼠标之外，后面解锁的鼠标都很有意思也有自己的特点，不同的鼠标玩法也不同，根据不同的攻击方式需要拿的模组流派也不同，但是所有的目标都是打败敌人，找到文件夹中的boss，打败后领取奖励前往下一个磁盘。 游戏在各种文件夹中有一些带着各种名称的文件，点击后有概率获得一个金币，而大部分文件夹上面带有病毒标志的就代表战斗关卡，压缩文件也会有一个精英压缩包战斗，挑战文件夹则是里面会固定有一个奖励，但是战斗非常困难，boss文件夹打通后就能拿到奖励和数据碎片，然后前往下一个磁盘，商店文件夹可以消耗金币购买模组或者主动道具。 游戏中也有各种成就和挑战可以让玩家解锁，想要解锁新的鼠标就必须完成鼠标任务，每次游戏时获得的数据碎片可以购买一些开局奖励之类的，还有一些桌面栏的小挂饰，像素小人，鼠标尾迹之类的装饰性道具，游戏中也有各种隐藏的小游戏EXE文件，可以根据分数来获得奖励，文档的名字也很有梗，有时间的可以慢慢的看一看各种玩梗的文件夹。 [h2] 「♥总结♥」 [/h2] 病毒识别：拯救系统是一款单手就能游玩的弹幕肉鸽游戏，游戏还是很有挑战性的，一个不注意就可能掉很多的血暴毙，不同的鼠标不同的玩法也让人很想重开一局试试，推荐给喜欢弹幕肉鸽的玩家入手游玩。 [table][td]欢迎关注鉴赏家[url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45519015/]“无趣评测”[/url][/td][/table]
看着老式电脑的画风，操控鼠标来攻击和躲避病毒，有种回到以前玩电脑的感觉，需要一定的鼠标操控的精确度，玩起来比较废手，挺有意思的一款肉鸽游戏，但还是存在着不少的问题，各个难度相差过大，不利于新人游玩，并且不同鼠标（角色）上下限也差别很大，个别的玩的手都疼了，很不友好，并且默认画面光污染严重，第一次玩眼都要花了，还有点击文件这个每个都得点也太麻烦了，还有一些小问题和BUG，可以等正式版再观望观望。

Have you ever played Pokemon Ranger for the Nintendo DS? This is that if Undertale and a Roguelike ran a train on it. Lots of references in the file names, good music, fun boss battles, and a surprising amount of content for a unique early access game. Very fun, and highly recommend. Here's a tip; increase your mouse sensitivity in the game. Otherwise your wrist will be very unhappy with you after a run.

Great idea and solid execution. Feels like a mix of Undertale and an aim trainer. Lots of potential here if it can be fleshed out more. I hope the team can spend more time on tuning the different cursors. As it stands it feels like many cursors require a lot of risky movement and action for little reward. The selection cursor feels both easiest to use and the strongest, since it can also easily combine with other cursors if you can get them with legendary mods (e.g. rythm cursor or the click cursor). The combo system needs some additional mods that interact with it, at the moment it feels like crit and attack damage are the only options. Mods that add friendly projectiles fees great but impact visibility a lot (looking at you User Daggers). Runs are a bit short at the moment making me sad to have to abandon my build when it feels like I just reached a scaling point. 10/10 potential, 8/10 in the current state.

Really unique concept and tons of fun. I wouldn't suggest this for someone with carpal tunnel or wrist issues. I can only really do one run at a time as well because this game is really tough on the wrist. Maybe I am not good enough at it yet, but it seriously challenges your ability to click fast, or spin the mouse. Do not play with low DPI. However, warning aside, I really have enjoyed my time with this game and I look forward to the devs making more progress. Hopefully this will not fall victim to the early access curse and be abandoned.

This game doesn't have a lot going on with it. Everything is so basic, the procedural dungeons feel tacked on due to no strategy involved with them. And that could be said about a lot of the game, there's little decision making involved. This game is pretty much skill based. I recognize it is still in early access, but this is how it is inherently.

It is a quick and fun game that is easy to get into and I really want to play it more. The problem comes when I get to the third boss, as my whole computer lags hard and even upon opening the task manager to force it to close I have to restart my whole computer. As a result I have lost so many runs due to some kind of memory leak or bloat that only this game causes. I do not have anything open in the background and my specs are not below the minimum, so I have no clue what is happening other than something to do with the game. If you want to take a chance, it is very fun, but if you worry about your computer's well-being then probably wait for an update, patch, or hot-fix. :(

Identifile: Desktop Dungeon is a unique rogue-lite dungeon crawler and action computer game. Unlike most dungeon crawlers, this game is set within a simulated computer operating system, with its four disk drives as its dungeons. The objective of this game is to use the cursor of your choice, even with its own playstyle, to fight back computer viruses, each with its own attack pattern, and defeat the four boss viruses, whilst avoiding enemy fire. The point-and-click combat in this game is reminiscent of that of the Fly Swatter mini-game in Mario Paint for the Super Nintendo. And not all selectable cursors require you to click on enemies to defeat them. This can help reduce hand strain, especially when you do not feel like rapid-clicking. For example, the Selection Cursor only requires you to hover your mouse over viruses to attack them via damage-per-second (DPS). The Recycling Cursor requires you to hover your mouse over collectible files to use as a rotating barrier, much like the Leaf Shield, and similar weapons in the Mega Man series. As you play this game multiple times, you are more likely to unlock new cursors to experiment with, as well as equippable in-game mods to improve your chances of victory. For example, one of the unlockable mods also you to start your run with a random sub-weapon. Another unlockable mod increases your maximum health by one heart. All in all, Identifile: Desktop Dungeon is a simple but thrilling and unique dungeon-crawling experience which pays homages to various pre-existing games and online media, past and present. So, if you are a fan of dungeon-crawling games or are looking for a unique retro-PC experience, Identifile may be the game for you.

Just finished 100%ing this particular game. I absolutely love concept and gameplay loop. Can get grindy at times but not too critical. Has a lot of room to grow to, and considering this is still isn't a fully released game yet (version 0.1.3 in time of writing this review) - this is great. Will wait for future updates and new achievements!
Bullet hell roguelike from Singapore.
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullet hell rogue-like where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms! From Gearbyte Games - Singapore.
Play as a top-tier rogue in the 'Stranger PC' setting. Dodge projectiles and enemies by circling them with your cursor and dealing damage. It's much more fun than it sounds!
A roguelike played as various mouses each with unique attacks like damaging enemies in selection windows & Pokemon Ranger style loop drawing. The level navigation is unique: you explore system files.
This is a certified indie gem!
Identifile: Desktop Dungeon turns you into a cursor battling viruses in bullet hell file dungeons! Circle nasty foes, grab powerful EXEs & mods & conquer evil cursors & drives.
